en: Black‑and‑white historical view of a broad, cobblestoned urban boulevard lined with grand multi‑story Neo‑Renaissance and Neo‑Baroque buildings. Horse‑drawn carriages and early streetcars share the street with many pedestrians in late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century clothing. Trees and shop awnings line the sidewalks. On the right stands a large curved corner building with domed roof elements; distant church or tower spires rise along the avenue.
